title: Content takedown request
subtitle: For content owners or their authorized representatives.
intro1: VidGrab does not store users' videos long-term: files exist only temporarily so that you can download them, and then expire on their own. The original content remains on the platform where it was posted, so if you want it removed completely, you also need to notify that platform.
intro2: Every request is reviewed manually. To help us process it quickly, please provide:
li1: The link to the content on the original platform, and whether you are the owner or a representative.
li2: A link or description related to VidGrab (if any), for example a download link that was shared.
li3: A clear description of your request and an email address so we can reply.
otherHelp: Need other help? Email us at
doneText: We will review it and reply to the email address you provided. Thank you.
